name: typo3-agentic-toolkit
description: Build TYPO3 v13/v14 extensions and site packages with the concepts of the last year (site sets, Fluid components, Schema API, record objects, Extbase authorization and rate limiting, Symfony translations, system resources, CSP hashes) using skills, a team of specialised subagents, guard hooks, output styles, LSP, MCP, monitors, workflows and evals.

php_runner.title: PHP runner
php_runner.description: How scripts and hooks run PHP: auto (DDEV, then host, then Docker), ddev, host or docker.

strict_guard.title: Strict guard
strict_guard.description: Deny (instead of ask) edits to vendor/, var/, public/typo3/ and generated files.

dev_companion_path.title: TYPO3 Dev Companion checkout
dev_companion_path.description: Optional path to a git checkout of github.com/TYPO3/dev-companion. When set, its MCP server starts with the plugin.
